svg.title: 04-reference-seeded-scba-seed
svg.desc: Two-panel Reference-seeded SCBA initialization: actual24-atom silicon short reference supplies the self-energy seed for the actual56-atom target, which is then re-equilibrated. All atoms and periodic-cell boundaries remain marked. Interaction lengths0.543356003and2.716780015nm; full lengths1.630068009and3.803492021nm. Both crystal views use the same scale per unit cell.

g.aria-label: 24 silicon input positions, 1.63 nanometre device, 0.54 nanometre selected interaction region
g.title: Silicon calculation input: 3 conventional cells
g.desc: Exact input fractional positions projected orthographically; a=5.43356003 angstrom, [100] transport. Transverse directions are periodic. Dashed layer boundaries mark the conventional-cell repeat. Atom positions are not jittered. Lengths span cell boundaries.

g.aria-label: 56 silicon input positions, 3.80 nanometre device, 2.72 nanometre selected interaction region
g.title: Silicon calculation input: 7 conventional cells
g.desc: Exact input fractional positions projected orthographically; a=5.43356003 angstrom, [100] transport. Transverse directions are periodic. Dashed layer boundaries mark the conventional-cell repeat. Atom positions are not jittered. Lengths span cell boundaries.

g.text: The short reference is an initial guess. The target scattering is updated.
